risk_reasons: Four transactional write sites inside the solicitation generation path, each in a transaction that already holds the batch advisory lock and the batch row lock. A ledger failure aborts the render it records.
The generation path decides during an LLM round trip and persists afterwards, so a wrong occurred_at compiles, passes every CHECK and records the wrong time silently.
The solicitation send path reaches real recipients.
goal: All four outreach render writers in src/lib/solicitation/ask-generation.ts record an outreach_withheld Refusal against the outreach they withhold, stamped with the same renderedAt the outreach row carries.
non_goals: The outreach_withheld DISPATCH site in commitWithhold. #1010 owns it, and it carries a different reason enum.
The ask_withheld and batch_halted lanes. #1010 owns them.
The held_draft and policy_gate_held lanes. #1013 owns them.
The Restraint tab and any read over refusal_events. #1014 owns the read path.
The lane category maps. The feat/refusal-lane-vocabulary prerequisite lands them on main before this branch arms.
The set-based arm of writeRefusalEvent. #1010 adds it; every writer in this lane writes exactly one row.
Any migration, and any change to which renders are withheld or why.
user_visible_behavior: No owner-visible change. Nothing reads refusal_events until #1014.
A withheld child render writes one refusal_events row against the outreach id, in the same transaction as the outreach insert.
A regenerated ask writes its Refusal against the replacement outreach id, so the row it replaced keeps its own Refusal.
A budget stop and a generation exhaustion each write one refusal_events row per outreach they settle as withheld.
Setting REFUSAL_LEDGER_ENABLED=false stops all four without a deploy and leaves generation behaviour byte-identical to today.
invariants: occurredAt is the renderedAt the same call passes to insertOutreachRender, so refusal_events.occurred_at equals solicitation_outreach.rendered_at exactly. One Date object, both columns.
The transaction-time sentinel is never used in this lane. It would stamp persist time, and the equality with rendered_at is the property this lane trades on.
Every writer passes the outreach id the render just minted as subject_id. regenerateAsk's replacement row has a new id and is a distinct subject.
One Refusal per withheld outreach, never one per attempt and never one per batch.
A rendered outcome writes nothing. Only status withheld is a Refusal.
The ledger write is in the same transaction as the outreach insert it records, and is never caught at the call site.
src/lib/refusals/write.ts is not edited. This lane consumes the single-row helper as shipped by #1009.
Every row carries the account_id and business_id already on the generation context.
Tenant isolation: every row carries account_id NOT NULL and the table keeps deny-all RLS.
edge_cases: The LLM round trip is slow and the advisory lock then blocks: occurred_at is still renderedAt, which is minted once and written to both tables.
A render succeeds: no Refusal, because nothing was withheld.
regenerateAsk replaces a withheld outreach with another withheld outreach: two Refusals, one per outreach id, because two decisions were made.
A stale outbox attempt loses the ownership CAS: persistChildRender returns before any insert, so no Refusal is written.
The batch halted or expired while the LLM call was in flight: the lifecycle re-check refuses the insert, so no Refusal is written either.
settleBudgetStop settles several outreach rows in one call: one Refusal per outreach, each with its own subject id.
settleGenerationExhaustion writes render_failed after every attempt is spent: one Refusal, not one per attempt.
REFUSAL_LEDGER_ENABLED is false: every render still persists and the helper emits one warning per disabled episode.
A CHECK violation from a writer bug aborts the persist transaction, so the outreach row does not exist either. The render is retried by its outbox attempt.

src/lib/refusals/write.ts — the single-row helper and its per-lane input union.
src/lib/solicitation/ask-generation.ts toInsertInput — the one place renderedAt is minted, and the value both tables must share.
src/lib/solicitation/outreach.ts insertOutreachRender — the insert this write accompanies, and the owner of RenderWithholdReason.
src/lib/refusals/vocabulary.ts — the render lane map landed by the feat/refusal-lane-vocabulary prerequisite.
test_seams: src/lib/solicitation/ask-generation.ts — the batch generation entry point, through which all four writers are reached.
src/lib/solicitation/outreach.ts — insertOutreachRender, whose rendered_at the ledger row must equal.
tests_to_add: a withheld child render writes one refusal_events row against the outreach id
a successful child render writes no refusal_events row
every render-lane refusal_events row carries occurred_at equal to the solicitation_outreach rendered_at of the same insert
the render lane never stamps occurred_at from the transaction, so a slow lock does not move the decision time
a budget stop writes one refusal_events row per outreach it settles as withheld
a generation exhaustion writes one refusal_events row for the outreach it withholds, not one per attempt

a regenerated ask leaves the replaced outreach row's own refusal_events row untouched

every render-lane refusal_events row carries subject_type solicitation_outreach and the account and location of the generation context
a stale outbox attempt writes neither an outreach row nor a refusal_events row

rollback_plan: Three layers. (1) REFUSAL_LEDGER_ENABLED=false on Railway stops every ledger write with no deploy and leaves generation byte-identical to today; invoke the flag-flip skill. (2) Revert the PR on main and redeploy, which removes all four call sites together. (3) No down migration: migration 116 stays and rows already written are not deleted. ArchivalPoller's refusal_events arm landed in #1009 and is untouched, so surviving rows still age out at REFUSAL_LEDGER_RETENTION_DAYS.
observability: One warning per disabled episode from the helper whenever REFUSAL_LEDGER_ENABLED is false.
A ledger failure in this lane reaches Sentry through attachJobFailureSink on the terminal BullMQ attempt, because generation runs inside a BullMQ worker.

Reconciliation query for staging: COUNT(*) of refusal_events WHERE refusal_source = 'outreach_withheld' AND subject_id IN the batch's outreach ids must equal the count of solicitation_outreach rows with delivery_status withheld and a render disposition_reason, inside the retention window.
